From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: Acme POC kickoff recap & next steps

Hi Samantha / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time this morning — great conversation and excited to get the POC started. Below is a concise recap of what we discussed and the immediate next steps so we’re aligned.

Goals / success metrics (agreed):
- Improve customer support deflection by 25% on targeted product flows (chat + retrieval).
- Reduce average latency for generative responses under 400ms 95th percentile for web users.
- Demonstrate cost savings vs current baseline (target: 30% token cost reduction with caching/quantization).

Primary pain points you shared:
- Slow responses for long-context tickets, especially when agents hit KB searches.
- High unit-cost due to duplicate prompt prefixes and lack of caching.
- Tight security/compliance requirements (SSO + data residency for logs).

POC scope (what Redwood will deliver):
- 4-week pilot: data ingest + prompt tuning + inference config.
- Evaluate on one product area: Support Inbox (last 12 months of tickets, anonymized).
- Deliverables: baseline benchmark, prompt set & evals, recommended runtime config (batching/quantization), final report.

Owners & roles:
- Acme: Samantha Lee (POC lead), Tom Rogers (Engineering owner)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE, program manager), Aditya Rao (Solutions Engineer), Rishi Malhotra (Solutions lead for performance).

Timeline (high-level):
- Week 0 (this week): access + sample data delivery, security checklist start, kick-off meeting scheduled for Monday 7/19.
- Week 1: data ingest + baseline evals.
- Week 2: prompt tuning + intermediate evals.
- Week 3: runtime optimization (batching, caching) + cost modeling.
- Week 4: final report & next steps (production plan / Dedicated recommendation).

Immediate asks for Acme:
1) Provide SSO/Okta admin contact + service account for API access.
2) Drop a 1K-row sample of anonymized support tickets (CSV or S3 link).
3) Confirm timeline for security questionnaire (SOC2 evidence) — we can start with the initial checklist attached.

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_POC_Scope_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

Next steps:
- Samantha to share sample data and Okta admin by end of day Friday 7/16.
- We’ll schedule the technical kickoff for Mon 7/19 (calendar invite pending).

If anything above is off, say so and I’ll update. Otherwise I’ll mark this as the working POC plan and loop in engineering to prep envs.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
